config.script:
function_name=self.view.params.data.function_name
	machine_name=self.parent.parent.getChild("EQ-Number").getChild("TextField").props.text
	function_id=self.view.params.data.function_id
	input_params_instances=self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexRepeater").props.instances
	username='User-Interface'
	
	##get sys interface
	parameters={"function_id":function_id}
	sys_interface=system.db.execScalar("API/Configurations/Get_Sys_Interface_Function_Call",parameters)
	
	payload={"machine_name":machine_name,
			 "function_name":function_name,
			 "input_parameters":{}}	
	#system.perspective.print(input_params_instances)	
	for param in input_params_instances:
	
		payload['input_parameters'][param['data']['param_name']]=param['data']['param_value']
		
	

	system.perspective.print(payload)	
	execution_call=API.Functions.execution(payload,sys_interface, simulator_call="YES")
	
	response=execution_call
	#system.perspective.print(response)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("getResult", response)
